subject: table: simplify the locate partition args for `PartitionedTable` (#53432)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: `table.PartitionedTable` APIs (`GetPartitionByRow`, `GetPartitionIdxByRow`, `CheckForExchangePartition`) now take `expression.EvalContext` instead of `expression.BuildContext`, and all touched call sites in executor/planner/table pass `GetExprCtx().GetEvalCtx()` accordingly. `pkg/table/tables/partition.go` is refactored to evaluate partition expressions directly with the provided `EvalContext` and removes redundant re-parsing of the partition expression purely for `ErrNoPartitionForGivenValue` message construction; partition selection logic itself remains the same. Checked later history on `upstream/master` for the touched files and did not see a follow-up fix that suggests a Blocker/High issue in this refactor.
